```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 11, fig.height = 7, dpi = 120)
```

# 0. Packages

Run once (not evaluated when knitting). The old script installed `BASEmetab`
and `LakeMetabolizer`; those are lake tools and are no longer needed.

```{r install, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "zoo", "scales", "patchwork", "leaflet", "plotly", "ranger"))
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("DOI-USGS/streamMetabolizer")  # also needs rstan for the Bayesian option
```

```{r libs}
library(tidyverse)   # dplyr, tidyr, readr, ggplot2, lubridate, purrr
library(zoo)         # gap interpolation
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(streamMetabolizer)
```

# 1. Settings

Everything you might want to change lives here.

```{r config}
# ---- paths ------------------------------------------------------------------
DATA_DIR   <- "project/data"   # CSU_ROSS_<year>_cleaned.csv live here
META_FILE  <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "site_metadata.csv")
OUT_DIR    <- "dashboard_data"                # tidy tables for the dashboard
FIG_DIR    <- "figures"                       # static PNGs
CACHE_DIR  <- "model_cache"                   # one .rds per site-year fit
walk(c(OUT_DIR, FIG_DIR, CACHE_DIR), dir.create, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- model ------------------------------------------------------------------
# "bayes": K600 held near a per-site prior (recommended, slow, needs rstan)
# "mle"  : fast preview only; K600 is fit freely and trades off with ER
MODEL_TYPE     <- "bayes"
RUN_MODELS     <- TRUE      # FALSE = only read what is already in CACHE_DIR
K600_DEFAULT   <- 30        # 1/d, used for sites with no K600_prior in site_metadata.csv
K600_SDLOG     <- 0.15      # prior width (log scale); small = K600 nearly fixed
MIN_DEPTH_M    <- 0.05      # depth readings below this are treated as sensor error
STEPS_PER_DAY  <- 96        # 15-minute data
MAX_GAP_STEPS  <- 8         # interpolate gaps up to 2 h; longer gaps drop the day
MIN_DAYS_FIT   <- 5         # skip site-years with fewer modelable days
EXCLUDE_SITES  <- c("pman", "penn", "lbea")   # dropped from every figure, model run and export

# ---- QC on model output (Appling et al. 2018 style plausibility rules) -------
GPP_MAX        <- 50        # g O2 m-2 d-1
ER_MIN         <- -100      # ER is NEGATIVE in streamMetabolizer
RHAT_MAX       <- 1.1       # Bayesian runs only
MIN_DAYS_MONTH <- 5         # minimum good days to report a monthly mean
MAX_LINE_GAP_DAYS <- 7      # break plotted lines across longer gaps (sonde pulls)
```

# 2. Read the yearly files

The cleaned files are now long format (`DateTime_UTC, site, parameter, units,
value_raw, value_final, user_qc_flag`). `value_final` is already `NA` where a
point was excluded by QC, so no extra filtering of flags is needed. Year files
overlap at the boundaries, so duplicate rows are removed.

```{r read}
param_map <- c("DO" = "do_mgl", "Temperature" = "temp_c", "Depth" = "depth_m",
               "Specific Conductivity" = "spc_uscm", "Turbidity" = "turb_ntu",
               "pH" = "ph", "ORP" = "orp_v",
               "Chl-a Fluorescence" = "chla_rfu", "FDOM Fluorescence" = "fdom_rfu")

read_ross <- function(path) {
  read_csv(path, progress = FALSE,
           col_types = cols(DateTime_UTC = col_character(), site = col_character(),
                            parameter = col_character(), units = col_character(),
                            value_raw = col_double(), value_final = col_double(),
                            user_qc_flag = col_character(), modifications = col_character())) |>
    filter(parameter %in% names(param_map)) |>
    transmute(datetime = ymd_hms(DateTime_UTC, tz = "UTC"),
              site, var = unname(param_map[parameter]), value = value_final)
}

files <- list.files(DATA_DIR, pattern = "^CSU_ROSS_\\d{4}_cleaned\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
stopifnot(length(files) > 0)

sensor <- map(files, read_ross) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  arrange(is.na(value)) |>                                   # keep the non-NA copy of duplicates
  distinct(datetime, site, var, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = var, values_from = value) |>
  arrange(site, datetime) |>
  filter(!site %in% EXCLUDE_SITES)

cat("Rows:", nrow(sensor), "| Sites:", n_distinct(sensor$site),
    "| Range:", format(min(sensor$datetime)), "to", format(max(sensor$datetime)))
```

# 3. Site metadata

`site_metadata.csv` (provided alongside this script) was built from
`CSU_ROSS_sonde_location_metadata.csv`: one row per site using its **current**
sonde location (ELC and Bellvue were moved; the shift is a few hundred metres,
which does not matter for solar time or light). It also holds a K600 prior,
display labels, a plotting order (roughly upstream to downstream, Poudre
mainstem first, then tributaries; edit `order` to change it), and the gauge
named in `flow_source`. Elevation is filled in for four sites and fetched from
the coordinates with `elevatr` for the rest (needs internet). Sites that end up
without lat/lon/elevation cannot be modeled but still appear in every figure
as "no estimate".

```{r meta}
site_meta <- read_csv(META_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)
if (!"K600_sdlog" %in% names(site_meta)) site_meta$K600_sdlog <- NA_real_   # written by k600_from_flow.Rmd
site_meta <- site_meta |>
  mutate(K600_prior = coalesce(K600_prior, K600_DEFAULT),
         K600_sdlog = coalesce(K600_sdlog, K600_SDLOG))

# any site in the data but not in the metadata file is appended
extra <- setdiff(unique(sensor$site), site_meta$site)
if (length(extra)) site_meta <- bind_rows(site_meta, tibble(site = extra, site_label = toupper(extra), K600_prior = K600_DEFAULT, K600_sdlog = K600_SDLOG))

site_meta <- site_meta |>
  mutate(order = coalesce(order, 100 + rank(site, ties.method = "first"))) |>
  arrange(order) |>
  filter(site %in% sensor$site)

site_levels <- site_meta$site
site_labels <- site_meta$site_label
as_site_f   <- function(x) factor(x, levels = site_levels, labels = site_labels)

# fill missing elevation from coordinates if elevatr is available
need_elev <- which(is.na(site_meta$elev_m) & !is.na(site_meta$lat) & !is.na(site_meta$lon))
if (length(need_elev) && requireNamespace("elevatr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pts <- data.frame(x = site_meta$lon[need_elev], y = site_meta$lat[need_elev])
  site_meta$elev_m[need_elev] <- elevatr::get_elev_point(pts, prj = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84", src = "aws")$elevation
}

modelable <- site_meta |> filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon), !is.na(elev_m)) |> pull(site)
skipped   <- setdiff(site_levels, modelable)
if (length(skipped)) message("No coordinates/elevation, not modeled: ", paste(skipped, collapse = ", "))
```

# 4. Shared look for every figure

```{r theme}
gpp_col <- "#2E8B57"; er_col <- "#C0562B"; nep_pos <- "#2E8B57"; nep_neg <- "#8C510A"

theme_metab <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 4),
          plot.subtitle   = element_text(colour = "grey35", margin = margin(b = 8)),
          strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
          axis.title      = element_text(colour = "grey25"),
          legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
}
theme_set(theme_metab())

lab_gpp <- expression(GPP~(g~O[2]~m^{-2}~d^{-1}))
lab_er  <- expression(ER~(g~O[2]~m^{-2}~d^{-1}))
lab_nep <- expression(NEP~(g~O[2]~m^{-2}~d^{-1}))

save_fig <- function(p, name, w = 12, h = 8) ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# adds a quiet "no estimate" tag to facets that have no data
tag_empty <- function(p, data, ...) {
  empty <- setdiff(levels(as_site_f(site_levels)), unique(as.character(data$site_f)))
  if (!length(empty)) return(p)
  p + geom_text(data = tibble(site_f = factor(empty, levels = levels(as_site_f(site_levels)))),
                aes(label = "no estimate"), x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.6,
                size = 3, colour = "grey55", inherit.aes = FALSE)
}
```

# 5. Where do we have data?

Which sites were deployed when. The set of sites changes every year, so this
is the reference for reading every later figure.

```{r coverage, fig.height=7}
coverage <- sensor |>
  filter(!is.na(do_mgl)) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(datetime), month = floor_date(date, "month")) |>
  group_by(site, month) |>
  summarise(days = n_distinct(date), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(site_f = as_site_f(site))

p_cov <- ggplot(coverage, aes(month, fct_rev(site_f), fill = days)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "mako", direction = -1, name = "Days with DO data") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y", expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Sonde deployment coverage", subtitle = "Days per month with dissolved-oxygen data; gaps are winter pulls and outages",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(), panel.grid = element_blank())
p_cov
save_fig(p_cov, "01_deployment_coverage", 12, 6)
```

# 6. Build model inputs

streamMetabolizer needs `solar.time, DO.obs, DO.sat, depth, temp.water, light`
on a regular 15-minute grid. Changes from the original script:

* **Measured depth** replaces the constant `0.5 m` (readings below `MIN_DEPTH_M` are treated as sensor error).
* Short gaps (up to 2 h) are interpolated; **any day that still has missing data is dropped** rather than fed to the model.
* Each "model day" is the 04:00 to 04:00 mean-solar-time window the package uses.

```{r inputs}
model_input <- sensor |>
  filter(site %in% modelable) |>
  select(site, datetime, do_mgl, temp_c, depth_m) |>
  mutate(depth_m = if_else(depth_m < MIN_DEPTH_M, NA_real_, depth_m)) |>
  group_by(site) |>
  complete(datetime = seq(min(datetime), max(datetime), by = "15 min")) |>
  arrange(datetime, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(across(c(do_mgl, temp_c, depth_m),
                ~ zoo::na.approx(.x, maxgap = MAX_GAP_STEPS, na.rm = FALSE))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(site_meta |> select(site, lat, lon, elev_m), by = "site") |>
  group_by(site) |>
  mutate(
    solar.time = calc_solar_time(datetime, longitude = lon[1]),   # mean solar time, as in the original script
    light      = calc_light(solar.time, latitude = lat[1], longitude = lon[1], attach.units = FALSE),
    pressure   = calc_air_pressure(elevation = elev_m[1]),
    DO.sat     = calc_DO_sat(temp_c, pressure.air = pressure)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  rename(DO.obs = do_mgl, temp.water = temp_c, depth = depth_m) |>
  drop_na(DO.obs, DO.sat, temp.water, depth, light) |>
  mutate(model_date = as.Date(solar.time - hours(4))) |>
  group_by(site, model_date) |>
  filter(n() >= STEPS_PER_DAY) |>           # complete days only
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(site, solar.time) |>
  distinct(site, solar.time, .keep_all = TRUE)

model_input |> count(site, name = "usable_steps") |> mutate(usable_days = usable_steps / STEPS_PER_DAY)
```

# 7. Fit the models

**K600.** K600 cannot be measured here (no tracer studies) and, if left free,
it trades off against ER (Appling et al. 2018, *Sci. Data*/*JGR-Biogeosciences*).
With `MODEL_TYPE = "bayes"` each site gets a lognormal K600 prior centred on its
`K600_prior` with a narrow spread (`K600_SDLOG`). Replace the `K600_prior` column
in `site_metadata.csv` with reach-specific estimates (for example from
Raymond et al. 2012 hydraulic equations using each site's slope and velocity)
and re-run. Until then every site uses `K600_DEFAULT`, the value from the
original script.

Fits are cached per site-year in `model_cache/`, so re-knitting is fast and a
crash does not lose finished work. Test one site-year first before running everything.

```{r models}
make_specs <- function(K600, sdlog = K600_SDLOG) {
  if (MODEL_TYPE == "bayes") {
    nm <- mm_name(type = "bayes", pool_K600 = "none", err_obs_iid = TRUE, err_proc_iid = TRUE,
                  ode_method = "trapezoid", deficit_src = "DO_mod", engine = "stan")
    specs(nm, K600_daily_meanlog = log(K600), K600_daily_sdlog = sdlog,
          burnin_steps = 500, saved_steps = 500, n_chains = 2, n_cores = 2)
  } else {
    specs(mm_name(type = "mle"))
  }
}

fit_one <- function(dat, site, yr, K600, sdlog = K600_SDLOG) {
  cache_file <- file.path(CACHE_DIR, sprintf("%s_%s_%s.rds", MODEL_TYPE, site, yr))
  if (file.exists(cache_file)) return(readRDS(cache_file))
  if (!RUN_MODELS) return(NULL)
  message("Fitting ", site, " ", yr, " (", nrow(dat) / STEPS_PER_DAY, " days)")
  out <- tryCatch({
    fit <- metab(specs = make_specs(K600, sdlog), data = dat)
    left_join(as_tibble(predict_metab(fit)), as_tibble(get_params(fit)),
              by = "date", suffix = c("", ".par")) |>
      mutate(site = site)
  }, error = function(e) { message("  failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (!is.null(out)) saveRDS(out, cache_file)
  out
}

jobs <- model_input |> mutate(yr = year(model_date)) |> group_by(site, yr) |> group_split()

daily_raw <- map(jobs, \(d) {
  if (n_distinct(d$model_date) < MIN_DAYS_FIT) return(NULL)
  s <- d$site[1]
  fit_one(as.data.frame(select(d, solar.time, DO.obs, DO.sat, depth, temp.water, light)),
          s, d$yr[1], site_meta$K600_prior[site_meta$site == s], site_meta$K600_sdlog[site_meta$site == s])
}) |> bind_rows()

stopifnot("No model results found: check RUN_MODELS / model_cache" = nrow(daily_raw) > 0)
```

# 8. Clean results and derive NEP

**Sign convention:** in streamMetabolizer, ER is *negative* (oxygen consumed).
So **NEP = GPP + ER**. The original script used `GPP - ER`, which double-counts
respiration and is the likely cause of the extreme NEP values noted for CHD in 2024.

```{r clean}
daily_clean <- rename_with(daily_raw, ~ gsub("\\.", "_", .x))
for (cn in c("GPP_Rhat", "ER_Rhat", "K600_daily")) if (!cn %in% names(daily_clean)) daily_clean[[cn]] <- NA_real_

daily_all <- daily_clean |>
  transmute(site, date, GPP, ER, NEP = GPP + ER, PR = GPP / abs(ER),
            K600 = K600_daily, GPP_Rhat, ER_Rhat) |>
  mutate(
    year  = year(date), month = month(date),
    season = factor(case_when(month %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring", month %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
                              month %in% 9:11 ~ "Fall", TRUE ~ "Winter"),
                    levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Fall", "Winter")),
    qc_pass = GPP > 0 & ER < 0 & GPP <= GPP_MAX & ER >= ER_MIN &
      (is.na(GPP_Rhat) | GPP_Rhat < RHAT_MAX) & (is.na(ER_Rhat) | ER_Rhat < RHAT_MAX),
    site_f = as_site_f(site)
  )

daily <- filter(daily_all, qc_pass)

daily_all |> group_by(site) |>
  summarise(days_modeled = n(), days_kept = sum(qc_pass), pct_kept = round(100 * mean(qc_pass))) |>
  arrange(desc(days_modeled))
```

# 9. Figures

Every figure draws all sites in the data. Sites that were not modeled (or have
no passing days) appear as empty panels tagged "no estimate".

## 9.1 Daily GPP and ER

Points are daily values; lines are 7-day rolling means. ER is plotted below zero, GPP above, so the gap between them is NEP.

```{r ts-gpp-er, fig.height=12}
roll7 <- function(x) if (length(x) < 7) rep(NA_real_, length(x)) else as.numeric(stats::filter(x, rep(1/7, 7), sides = 2))

segment_gaps <- function(df, value_col) {
  df |> arrange(site_f, date) |>
    group_by(site_f) |>
    mutate(seg = cumsum(coalesce(as.numeric(date - lag(date)) > MAX_LINE_GAP_DAYS, FALSE))) |>
    group_by(site_f, seg) |>
    mutate(roll = roll7({{ value_col }})) |>
    ungroup()
}

ts_long <- daily |>
  pivot_longer(c(GPP, ER), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, c("GPP", "ER"))) |>
  arrange(site_f, metric, date) |>
  group_by(site_f, metric) |>
  mutate(seg = cumsum(coalesce(as.numeric(date - lag(date)) > MAX_LINE_GAP_DAYS, FALSE))) |>
  group_by(site_f, metric, seg) |>
  mutate(roll = roll7(value)) |>
  ungroup()

p_ts <- ggplot(ts_long, aes(date, value, colour = metric)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.6) +
  geom_line(aes(y = roll, group = interaction(metric, seg)), linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(GPP = gpp_col, ER = er_col)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  facet_wrap(~ site_f, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Daily gross primary production and ecosystem respiration",
       x = NULL, y = expression(g~O[2]~m^{-2}~d^{-1}))
p_ts <- tag_empty(p_ts, ts_long)
p_ts
save_fig(p_ts, "02_daily_gpp_er", 12, 13)
```

## 9.2 Net ecosystem production

Green = net autotrophic day (NEP > 0), brown = net heterotrophic (NEP < 0).

```{r ts-nep, fig.height=12}
nep_ts <- segment_gaps(daily, NEP)

p_nep <- ggplot(nep_ts, aes(date, NEP)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = NEP > 0), alpha = 0.35, size = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(aes(y = roll, group = seg), colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.6, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = nep_pos, `FALSE` = nep_neg)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  facet_wrap(~ site_f, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Daily net ecosystem production (NEP = GPP + ER)",
       subtitle = "Line = 7-day rolling mean", x = NULL, y = lab_nep)
p_nep <- tag_empty(p_nep, nep_ts)
p_nep
save_fig(p_nep, "03_daily_nep", 12, 13)
```

## 9.3 Monthly averages, one line per year

```{r monthly}
monthly <- daily |>
  group_by(site, site_f, year, month) |>
  summarise(n_days = n(),
            across(c(GPP, ER, NEP),
                   list(mean = ~ mean(.x), sd = ~ sd(.x), median = ~ median(.x)),
                   .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_days >= MIN_DAYS_MONTH)

plot_seasonal <- function(var, ylab, title) {
  p <- ggplot(monthly, aes(month, .data[[var]], colour = factor(year), group = year)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) + geom_point(size = 1.4) +
    scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "viridis", end = 0.9) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 3:11, labels = month.abb[3:11]) +
    facet_wrap(~ site_f, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y", drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title, subtitle = paste0("Months with at least ", MIN_DAYS_MONTH, " good days"),
         x = NULL, y = ylab)
  tag_empty(p, monthly)
}

p_m_gpp <- plot_seasonal("GPP_mean", lab_gpp, "Monthly mean GPP by year")
p_m_er  <- plot_seasonal("ER_mean",  lab_er,  "Monthly mean ER by year")
p_m_gpp; p_m_er
save_fig(p_m_gpp, "04_monthly_gpp", 12, 13)
save_fig(p_m_er,  "05_monthly_er",  12, 13)
```

## 9.4 Boxplots by year and by month

Box = interquartile range, line = median, white diamond = mean.

```{r boxplots, fig.height=12}
plot_box <- function(df, x, y, colour, ylab, title, xlabs = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]])) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_boxplot(fill = alpha(colour, 0.35), colour = colour, linewidth = 0.4,
                 outlier.size = 0.5, outlier.alpha = 0.4, width = 0.65) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, fill = "white", colour = "grey20", size = 1.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ site_f, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y", drop = FALSE) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = ylab)
  tag_empty(p, df)
}

daily_b <- daily |> mutate(year_f = factor(year), month_f = factor(month, 1:12, month.abb))

p_by_gpp <- plot_box(daily_b, "year_f",  "GPP", gpp_col, lab_gpp, "GPP by year")
p_by_er  <- plot_box(daily_b, "year_f",  "ER",  er_col,  lab_er,  "ER by year")
p_bm_gpp <- plot_box(daily_b, "month_f", "GPP", gpp_col, lab_gpp, "GPP by month")
p_bm_er  <- plot_box(daily_b, "month_f", "ER",  er_col,  lab_er,  "ER by month")
p_by_gpp; p_by_er; p_bm_gpp; p_bm_er
save_fig(p_by_gpp, "06_box_year_gpp", 12, 13); save_fig(p_by_er, "07_box_year_er", 12, 13)
save_fig(p_bm_gpp, "08_box_month_gpp", 12, 13); save_fig(p_bm_er, "09_box_month_er", 12, 13)
```

## 9.5 Is a site autotrophic or heterotrophic?

Points above the dashed 1:1 line have GPP > |ER| (net autotrophic).

```{r crossplot, fig.height=12}
lim <- c(0, quantile(c(daily$GPP, -daily$ER), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE))

p_cross <- ggplot(daily, aes(GPP, -ER, colour = factor(year))) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.9) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(option = "viridis", end = 0.9) +
  coord_equal(xlim = lim, ylim = lim) +
  facet_wrap(~ site_f, ncol = 4, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "GPP versus ecosystem respiration",
       x = lab_gpp, y = expression("|ER|"~(g~O[2]~m^{-2}~d^{-1})))
p_cross <- tag_empty(p_cross, daily)
p_cross
save_fig(p_cross, "10_gpp_vs_er", 12, 11)
```

## 9.6 Model check: K600

If the Bayesian option is used, K600 should sit tightly around each site's prior.
Wide scatter means the prior is too loose or the data cannot constrain it.

```{r k600, fig.height=12}
p_k <- daily_all |>
  filter(!is.na(K600)) |>
  ggplot(aes(date, K600)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.6, colour = "#33415C") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 year", date_labels = "%Y") +
  facet_wrap(~ site_f, ncol = 3, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Estimated K600", x = NULL, y = expression(K[600]~(d^{-1})))
p_k <- tag_empty(p_k, filter(daily_all, !is.na(K600)))
p_k
save_fig(p_k, "11_k600_check", 12, 13)
```

# 10. What drives metabolism?

Daily sensor covariates (temperature, conductivity, turbidity, pH, chl-a, fDOM,
depth as a stage proxy) plus mean daily light are joined to the daily GPP and
|ER|. No discharge or precipitation is in the sonde files. To add them as
overlays/drivers, save a file `flow_precip_daily.csv` in `DATA_DIR` with columns
`date, discharge_cms, precip_mm` and it will be picked up automatically.

```{r drivers-data}
covars_daily <- sensor |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(datetime, tz = "America/Denver")) |>
  group_by(site, date) |>
  summarise(across(any_of(c("temp_c", "spc_uscm", "turb_ntu", "ph", "orp_v", "chla_rfu", "fdom_rfu", "depth_m")),
                   ~ if (all(is.na(.x))) NA_real_ else mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
            .groups = "drop")

light_daily <- model_input |>
  group_by(site, date = model_date) |>
  summarise(par_mean = mean(light), .groups = "drop")

driver_df <- daily |>
  left_join(covars_daily, by = c("site", "date")) |>
  left_join(light_daily,  by = c("site", "date"))

flow_file <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "flow_precip_daily.csv")
if (file.exists(flow_file)) {
  driver_df <- left_join(driver_df, read_csv(flow_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |> mutate(date = as.Date(date)), by = "date")
}

driver_labels <- c(par_mean = "Light (PAR)", temp_c = "Water temperature", depth_m = "Depth (stage proxy)",
                   spc_uscm = "Specific conductivity", turb_ntu = "Turbidity", ph = "pH", orp_v = "ORP",
                   chla_rfu = "Chl-a fluorescence", fdom_rfu = "fDOM fluorescence",
                   discharge_cms = "Discharge", precip_mm = "Precipitation")
driver_vars <- intersect(names(driver_labels), names(driver_df))
```

## 10.1 Correlation of each driver with GPP and respiration, by site

Spearman rank correlation. Respiration is shown as magnitude (|ER|) so that a
positive correlation always means "more respiration". Grey = fewer than 30 paired days.

```{r drivers-cor, fig.height=7}
cors <- driver_df |>
  mutate(`|ER|` = -ER) |>
  pivot_longer(c(GPP, `|ER|`), names_to = "response", values_to = "resp") |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(driver_vars), names_to = "driver", values_to = "x") |>
  filter(!is.na(resp), !is.na(x)) |>
  group_by(site, site_f, response, driver) |>
  summarise(n = n(), rho = if (n() >= 30 && sd(x) > 0) cor(x, resp, method = "spearman") else NA_real_,
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(driver = factor(driver, levels = rev(driver_vars), labels = rev(driver_labels[driver_vars])))

p_cor <- ggplot(cors, aes(site_f, driver, fill = rho)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(rho), "", sprintf("%.2f", rho))), size = 2.6) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#B2182B", mid = "white", high = "#2166AC", limits = c(-1, 1),
                       na.value = "grey93", name = "Spearman\nrho") +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ response, ncol = 1) +
  labs(title = "Environmental correlates of metabolism", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text())
p_cor
save_fig(p_cor, "12_driver_correlations", 12, 9)
```

## 10.2 Which variables matter most (all sites pooled)

Random forest permutation importance, rescaled to percent of the total.
Predictors with more than 40% missing days are dropped first (chl-a and fDOM
were not recorded in every year). Day of year is included so seasonality is not
credited to temperature or light alone.

```{r drivers-rf, eval=requireNamespace("ranger", quietly = TRUE)}
rf_vars <- driver_vars[colMeans(!is.na(driver_df[driver_vars])) > 0.6]

rf_importance <- map(c(GPP = "GPP", `|ER|` = "ER_mag"), \(resp) {
  d <- driver_df |> mutate(ER_mag = -ER, doy = yday(date)) |>
    select(y = all_of(resp), all_of(rf_vars), doy) |> drop_na()
  rf <- ranger::ranger(y ~ ., data = d, num.trees = 500, importance = "permutation", seed = 1)
  imp <- pmax(rf$variable.importance, 0)
  tibble(driver = names(imp), pct = 100 * imp / sum(imp), n_days = nrow(d))
}) |> list_rbind(names_to = "response") |>
  mutate(driver = recode(driver, doy = "Day of year", !!!driver_labels))

p_rf <- ggplot(rf_importance, aes(pct, reorder(driver, pct), fill = response)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(GPP = gpp_col, `|ER|` = er_col)) +
  facet_wrap(~ response) +
  labs(title = "Relative importance of drivers", x = "Importance (% of total)", y = NULL)
p_rf
save_fig(p_rf, "13_driver_importance", 11, 5)
```

# 11. Interactive previews (dashboard prototypes)

A site map, and an interactive version of one site's time series. These are
the building blocks for the dashboard.

```{r map, eval=requireNamespace("leaflet", quietly = TRUE)}
map_df <- site_meta |>
  filter(!is.na(lat), !is.na(lon)) |>
  left_join(daily |> group_by(site) |>
              summarise(days = n(), GPP = mean(GPP), ER = mean(ER),
                        years = paste(range(year), collapse = "-")), by = "site")

leaflet::leaflet(map_df) |>
  leaflet::addProviderTiles(leaflet::providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  leaflet::addCircleMarkers(~lon, ~lat, radius = 8, color = "#264653", fillColor = "#2E8B57", fillOpacity = 0.85,
    label = ~site_label,
    popup = ~sprintf("<b>%s</b><br>%s m elev.<br>%s good days (%s)<br>mean GPP %.1f, mean ER %.1f",
                     site_label, elev_m, days, years, GPP, ER))
```

```{r plotly, eval=requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)}
first_site <- levels(droplevels(ts_long$site_f))[1]
plotly::ggplotly(
  ts_long |> filter(site_f == first_site) |>
    ggplot(aes(date, value, colour = metric, group = interaction(metric, seg))) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) + geom_line(aes(y = roll), na.rm = TRUE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(GPP = gpp_col, ER = er_col)) +
    labs(title = paste("Daily GPP and ER:", first_site), x = NULL, y = "g O2 / m2 / d"))
```

# 12. Export tidy tables for the dashboard

All tables are long/tidy with `site`, `site_label`, `date`, `year`, `month`
so a dashboard (Shiny, Observable, Power BI, etc.) can filter and toggle without
reshaping. Flagged-out days stay in `daily_metabolism.csv` with `qc_pass = FALSE`.

```{r export}
labels_df <- site_meta |> select(any_of(c("site", "site_label", "group", "lat", "lon", "elev_m", "K600_prior", "order", "description", "flow_source")))

daily_all |>
  select(-site_f) |>
  left_join(labels_df |> select(site, site_label), by = "site") |>
  write_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "daily_metabolism.csv"))

monthly |> select(-site_f) |> write_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "monthly_summary.csv"))

daily |>
  group_by(site, year) |>
  summarise(n_days = n(),
            across(c(GPP, ER, NEP), list(mean = ~ mean(.x), sd = ~ sd(.x), median = ~ median(.x)), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  write_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "yearly_summary.csv"))

driver_df |> select(-site_f) |> write_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "drivers_daily.csv"))
cors |> mutate(driver = as.character(driver), site_f = NULL) |> write_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "driver_correlations.csv"))
if (exists("rf_importance")) write_csv(rf_importance, file.path(OUT_DIR, "driver_importance.csv"))

labels_df |> write_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "site_metadata.csv"))
coverage |> select(-site_f) |> write_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "deployment_coverage.csv"))

list.files(OUT_DIR)
```

## 12.1 One file for the dashboard

`dashboard.html` reads a single file, `dashboard_data/data.js`. Keep `dashboard.html`
and the `dashboard_data/` folder together (same parent folder) and open the html file in a browser.
Optional inputs, picked up automatically if they exist in `dashboard_data/`:

* `k600_daily_by_site.csv` (written by `k600_from_flow.Rmd`): per-site daily flow for the flow overlay.
* `flow_precip_daily.csv` in `DATA_DIR` (columns `date, precip_mm`): precipitation overlay.
* `site_visits.csv`: columns `id, site, date, type, tech, notes, issue`. Use the Export button on the dashboard's
  Site visits tab to create it, then re-run this chunk so everyone sees the same visit log.

```{r dashboard-data}
library(jsonlite)

cols <- function(df) { df <- as_tibble(df); df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) if (inherits(x, c("Date", "POSIXt"))) format(x) else x); as.list(df) }
opt_csv <- function(path) if (file.exists(path)) read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL

sites_out <- site_meta |>
  filter(site %in% unique(daily_all$site) | site %in% sensor$site) |>
  mutate(flow_confidence = if ("flow_confidence" %in% names(pick(everything()))) coalesce(flow_confidence, "unknown") else "unknown") |>
  select(any_of(c("site", "site_label", "group", "lat", "lon", "elev_m", "description", "flow_confidence", "K600_prior", "K600_sdlog", "order")))

daily_out <- daily_all |> select(site, date, GPP, ER, NEP, PR, K600, qc_pass)

cov_cols <- c("temp_c", "spc_uscm", "turb_ntu", "ph", "orp_v", "chla_rfu", "fdom_rfu", "depth_m", "par_mean")
covars_out <- driver_df |> select(site, date, any_of(cov_cols))

flow_k <- opt_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "k600_daily_by_site.csv"))
flow_out <- if (!is.null(flow_k)) flow_k |> filter(site %in% sites_out$site) |> select(site, date, q_cms) else tibble(site = character(), date = as.Date(character()), q_cms = numeric())

pp <- opt_csv(file.path(DATA_DIR, "flow_precip_daily.csv"))
precip_out <- if (!is.null(pp) && "precip_mm" %in% names(pp)) pp |> transmute(date = as.Date(date), precip_mm) |> filter(!is.na(precip_mm)) else tibble(date = as.Date(character()), precip_mm = numeric())

vis <- opt_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "site_visits.csv"))
vis_out <- if (!is.null(vis)) vis |> mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) |> select(any_of(c("id", "site", "date", "type", "tech", "notes", "issue"))) else tibble(id = character(), site = character(), date = character(), type = character(), tech = character(), notes = character(), issue = character())

imp_out <- if (exists("rf_importance")) rf_importance |> select(response, driver, pct) else tibble(response = character(), driver = character(), pct = numeric())

payload <- list(
  generated = format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"),
  model = paste0(MODEL_TYPE, " (K600 prior from k600_from_flow.Rmd)"),
  sites = cols(sites_out), daily = cols(daily_out), covars = cols(covars_out), flow = cols(flow_out),
  precip = cols(precip_out), coverage = cols(coverage |> select(site, month, days)),
  importance = cols(imp_out), visits = cols(vis_out))

js <- toJSON(payload, dataframe = "columns", na = "null", digits = 4, auto_unbox = TRUE)
writeLines(paste0("window.RIVER_DATA = ", js, ";"), file.path(OUT_DIR, "data.js"))
cat("Wrote", file.path(OUT_DIR, "data.js"), "-", round(file.size(file.path(OUT_DIR, "data.js")) / 1e6, 1), "MB\n")
```

# 13. Notes to carry into the write-up

* Days failing the plausibility rules (GPP <= 0, ER >= 0, or beyond `GPP_MAX`/`ER_MIN`) are excluded from figures but kept in the export. Report how many were removed per site (table in section 8) rather than describing a y-axis clip, which replaces the old "limits = c(-100, 100)" approach.
* The two sites with almost no usable DO/depth days (`lbea`, `penn`) and sites without coordinates will show "no estimate".
* Because K600 is held near a site prior rather than measured, report GPP and ER as conditional on that K600 and, ideally, show sensitivity to a lower and higher prior.
